note: Pinned vendor source for the ROCm backend. ROCm 10.1 is the only verified toolchain (userland, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1); 6.4 (early probe) and 7.7 (original target) are historical.

primary.comment: The wheel builds from the fetched pinned tree (the repo root is the buildable `pip wheel .` source with the ROCm backend grafted in); the pin must resolve in the fork and `scripts/build-wheel.sh` fails loud otherwise. Pin = d3-36k pre-pin head (vendor sync to box SoT dcd1c69 + p2-sdpa S1 fix + b97-hbmfix: sync hipMalloc fallback + MLX_WORKER_DEBUG-gated diagnostics). The merge of this PR finalizes the pin. ROCm 10.1 note superseded by the box toolchain (see build comment).

build.comment: RX 9070 XT is gfx1201 (RDNA4), NOT gfx110x. ROCm 10.1 userland (amdrocm-*-dev10.1, core at /opt/rocm/core-10.1) provides hip/rocblas/rocprim/hiprand/hiprtc/hipblaslt/rocwmma; pass -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/opt/rocm/core-10.1 (see docs/quickstart.md).
